name: io.github.furkankoykiran/telegram-ads
title: Telegram Ads
description: MCP server for the official Telegram Ads API: ads, budgets, stats, audiences and pixels.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ADS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Telegram Ads API token from https://ads.telegram.org/account/api

environmentVariables.name: TG_ADS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: read-only (default) or write. Write tools also require confirm: true.

environmentVariables.name: TG_ADS_CODE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: off, read-only (default) or write. Controls the tg_execute sandbox.

environmentVariables.name: TG_ADS_ALLOWED_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist for explicit account_id values.

environmentVariables.name: TG_ADS_MAX_CPM
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-call CPM cap in the account currency.

environmentVariables.name: TG_ADS_MAX_AD_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-call ad budget or transfer cap in the account currency.

environmentVariables.name: TG_ADS_MAX_DAILY_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-call daily budget limit in the account currency.

environmentVariables.name: TG_ADS_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a JSONL audit log.
